This anchor will be attached to generation of every separate room. Target landscape3072x2048. Upper75% an elegant illustrated SIDE-ELEVATION MAP with twelve clearly distinct spaces connected by routes, stairs or marked doors. Lower25% three SMALL reference views: central scenery-only Arrival; pale-blue reflecting Pool; red-railed Courtyard. This is a map planning artifact, not production atlas, not isometric, not a webpage. Cohesive visible fine pixel art with controlled square clusters. No photorealism. No decorative slogans or subtitle. Sparse inhabitants. Huge backgrounds, ordinary-sized foreground furniture.

Fix this topology. Use ONLY these twelve room labels:
REST, ARRIVAL, REGISTRY, JUNCTION, VESTIBULE, ARENA, ARCHIVE, LOW PASSAGE, POOL, SKY WALK, EXHIBIT, COURTYARD.
Draw the main floor: REST at left -> a LARGE CENTRAL ARRIVAL panorama with ONE small centred spawn marker and a thin dashed box marking the first camera rectangle -> REGISTRY behind a large intervening support to the right, outside first camera -> JUNCTION -> VESTIBULE -> ARENA. The arrival room should be conspicuously BIGGER and emptier than the registry: it is scenery-only, no desk/bench/NPC/donor sign INSIDE the first camera rectangle. Rest is a small completed overlook with bench. Registry is an intimate accountant desk alcove with a warm lamp and tiny donation box. Vestibule safe outside arena; arena long flat clear fight floor with one white/charcoal/red constructed sword warden.
ARCHIVE is below Registry/Junction, with a stair to each so it makes a short loop. Ordinary freely opening door. Shelves/relevant materials, no puzzle gate.
The scenic route climbs from JUNCTION and turns BACK LEFT through LOW PASSAGE, then a paired BLUE-marked door leads to POOL above the left side of map. POOL has dry walkable rim and huge reflecting interior, no swimming. Physical passage from pool leads to SKY WALK crossing above the wide arrival void. A folding bridge across ONE actual gap, shown extended in this map, leads onward to EXHIBIT and then COURTYARD high to the right. Exhibit has blank neutral frames only. Courtyard has ONE distinctive tree and a RED HANDRAIL clearly recognisable in the initial distant view near registry. Courtyard return door uses matching RED frame marks to reconnect to REGISTRY, not central spawn or arena; use a RED DASHED planning connection. No redundant exhibit return elevator.
All solid route lines follow real floors/stairs; dashed links indicate paired doors. The shorter main route to arena uses thin warm-orange accent, scenic route turquoise. No walking lines through air. Exactly five little D marks for donation/top-donor points: Registry,Junction,Vestibule,Archive entrance,Exhibit foyer. No treasury room. No donor names, totals or fake data.

SHARED BACKGROUND IDENTITY: The same enormous pale ring and distant quiet city horizon should sit behind the ARRIVAL/REST/REGISTRY cluster and be recognisable at a different elevation behind SKY WALK/COURTYARD. Do not invent a new ring for each room. Use thin dotted sightlines from arrival to the ring and from registry to courtyard. Keep foreground scale consistent. Spatially strange but legible, familiar displaced rooms maintained by a few ordinary people. Denser rooms happen later; arrival stays still and majestic.
Text whitelist: "THE REGISTRY", the twelve room labels, "FIRST CAMERA", "SPAWN", "MAIN ROUTE", "SCENIC ROUTE", "DOOR LINK", "RESTORED RETURN", "D = donate + top donors". No other text. No slogan, subtitle, lore paragraph, UI or unrelated ornament.
This image must give the subsequent room-production artist a coherent big picture with the central arrival and its off-frame side destinations obvious.
